messages:
maria_support: Hey team, just got a customer escalation — after last night's canary rollout we shipped a micro-prompt tweak for the invoice-bot. They made a tiny phrasing change in the template and now line-items are being dropped from summaries. Customer says behavior changed exactly after 22:30 UTC.- jira: SUP-4921

josh_eng: Ugh. Can you paste the before/after prompt and a request ID? Also which model variant was on the canary?

maria_support: Request ID: rwd-req-0a1b2c3d, model: rw-instruct-13b-q4f-canary, region: eu-west-1.

maria_support: Before prompt (worked):
```
You are an invoice assistant. Summarize the invoice and list line items with description and amount.
Customer message:
<INVOICE_TEXT>
```

maria_support: After prompt (fragile):
```
You are an invoice assistant. Summarize the invoice. For each charge, list description and amount.
Customer message:
<INVOICE_TEXT>
```

anya_ml: That is basically the same wording, subtle rephrase. Could be a tokenization/WS issue or a model sensitivity to phrasing after quantization changes. Did they include any punctuation differences in the template engine?

maria_support: Customer confirmed they just changed "list line items with" -> "For each charge, list" — same placeholders. No extra punctuation.

josh_eng: Can you repro locally with the same model+quantization? Share curl.

maria_support: Repro command we used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-13b-q4f-canary","input":"You are an invoice assistant. For each charge, list description and amount.\nCustomer message:\nItem A - $10\nItem B - $20"}'
```

maria_support: Response truncated user-visible output: 
```
Summary: Total $30.
```
(no line items)

josh_eng: Ran same curl on prod non-canary model rw-instruct-13b-q4f (stable) — returns full items. So regression is tied to canary variant.

anya_ml: Copying log request traces to thread: deploy-bot shows new kernel selection + updated kv-cache behavior for q4f in canary. Might be a prompt parsing fallback when prompt phrasing maps to different attention pattern.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rw-instruct-13b-q4f-canary deployed 2024-04-22T22:10:12Z by josh_eng — rollout 15% traffic.

oliver_oncall: I'm going to flip the canary to 0% traffic and rollback the variant. Starting now.

oliver_oncall: Can confirm rollback initiated. Routing old variant back.

maria_support: Customer verified after rollback: line items returned. They still want to understand root cause before we re-release.

anya_ml: Next steps: 1) run a small prompt-sensitivity sweep on q4f-canary with micro-phrasing variations and templated placeholders; 2) check whether the quantization/attention kernel pick changed tokenization boundaries for common invoice templates; 3) add a defensive patch to the template renderer to normalize phrasing (e.g., standardize to "list line items with description and amount").

josh_eng: Agree. I'll open ENG-INCIDENT-2024-214 and attach diffs. Can someone grab the model debug dump for rwd-req-0a1b2c3d?

anya_ml: I have the debug dump, attaching link: https://internal.redwood/workspace/dumps/rwd-req-0a1b2c3d (restricted). Initial glance shows attention head fallback on step ~8 and an empty kv-cache write for the lines area.

maria_support: Customer asked for ETA on a fix. What's realistic?

anya_ml: Short term: prevent canary from rolling back to customers and add a canary gating rule for prompt-sensitivity failing on a curated prompt set — ETA 48h for gate + 24h for safe re-release.

josh_eng: Noted. I'll update the ticket and ping the account team. Assigning to @anya_ml and @oliver_oncall.

maria_support: Thanks all — I'll keep the customer posted and escalate if they see any further regressions. :pray:
